cases.title: Long background first, the ask, amount and date after word 120
cases.text: Over the past year, contributors have raised the state of the docs in calls, forums and threads. This proposal builds on that discussion and on the audit done in the summer, which found gaps in setup, examples and the reference. Several teams have since asked for one owner of the docs, and a first outline was shared in October. Reading through the threads, a few themes come up again and again: newcomers cannot find a first working example, the reference lags the code, and the same answers are repeated in chats. We also looked at how other projects organise their docs, at what a maintainer rota would cost in time, and at which pages are read most. We ask for 40,000 USDC to rewrite the docs in Q1, paid in two halves. We need a decision by December 5. If the proposal does not pass, the docs stay as they are.
